You have no shell. The change under review is the unified diff in .review-input/pr.diff (the PR's changes against the merge base); read it and the files it touches with Read. Files listed in .review-input/binary-paths.txt are shown by git as binary; Read them, because a NUL byte can hide a real change: a NUL byte in a source or text file is itself a finding, and a listed file you cannot read is a finding saying its change could not be reviewed.
